title: Behavioral Canarying for Prompt Injection: Powerless Model Probes with Explicit Coverage Semantics
description: Behavioral canarying is a pre-execution prompt-injection sensing architecture: untrusted input is deliberately exposed to a powerless language-model probe, and its response is examined for evidence of behavioral compromise before an authority-bearing agent acts.
